_source: lingxi-tui M7-11..15 screens via the live app::dispatch(Submit) slash-command intercept + root::handle_screen_key dispatcher; claude-code @ 2026-05-28-snapshot Doctor.tsx / ResumeConversation.tsx / Settings/ / memory/ / MessageSelector.
_note: Scripted screen flows driven through the SAME synchronous paths the live mount uses: slash-command opens via app::dispatch(KeyAction::Submit) (the live submit intercept), screen keys via the per-variant reducers (resume::handle_resume_key / settings::apply_settings_key / memory::handle_memory_key / message_selector::handle_message_selector_key), close via AppState::close_screen. Settings opens async in the live binary (pending_open_settings -> root::pump_open_settings); the sync half (raise the flag) is asserted here and the open is then driven directly via open_settings, mirroring the pump. Asserts STATE transitions + screen-row substrings (structure, not exact per-token color, per spec §0 Q3).
